description: SvDockManager header positions in Svelte 5: the tab strip can sit on any side of a panel through headerPosition, top, bottom, left or right, with left and right rendering vertical tabs, and tab reordering can be turned off with reorderEnabled. Dock, float, auto-hide and pop-out keep working in every position.

faq.question: How do vertical tabs read?
faq.answer: With headerPosition left or right the tab labels rotate along the strip and the active tab connects to the panel, the way IDE side bars do.

faq.question: Can different panels use different positions?
faq.answer: The prop applies to the manager as a whole so the workspace stays consistent; a per-panel override is not part of this demo.

faq.question: Why turn reordering off?
faq.answer: For fixed workspaces where tab order carries meaning, or where a drag should always mean dock rather than reorder.
